title: Routing fuel tankers to meet drivers along their routes on a city road network (code and data)
description:
Code and data of the computational study in the article Routing fuel tankers to meet drivers along their routes on a city road network by Pouria Tajasob and S. Mohammad J. Mirzapour Al-e-Hashem (manuscript under review, 2026).

The record holds the drivable road network of Tehran extracted from OpenStreetMap on 12 June 2026 with OSMnx 2.0.1, the 70 instances of the study, the 980 result records, the CPLEX logs and solutions of the 140 integer programs, and the Python code that reads the instances, builds their meeting candidates, runs the construction rules and the adaptive large neighbourhood search, exports the integer programs, replays every plan on a separately built graph and produces the tables and figures of the article. README.md describes the files and the commands.
